title: Understand URL and file paths
summary: A URL path and a filesystem path are different. DocumentRoot usually provides the base used to map a URL path to a file.
introduction: A URL path and a filesystem path are different. DocumentRoot usually provides the base used to map a URL path to a file. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain understand url and file paths
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A URL path and a filesystem path are different. DocumentRoot usually provides the base used to map a URL path to a file.
The mapping joins the public path to the chosen root. Other directives can change this mapping.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not let a user choose an arbitrary filesystem path.
For more detail later, use this [Apache HTTP Server further reading](https://httpd.apache.org/docs/2.4/getting-started.html).
